reusable_weapons.name: SUCCESSIVE_EXACT_FACTOR_SQUARECLASS_DESCENT
reusable_weapons.pattern: Factor the reconstruction square condition into low-degree primitive binary forms; bound pairwise gcds/resultants; enumerate only finitely supported common squareclasses; use parity/local solubility to kill branches; parameterize a surviving conic and repeat before invoking generic elliptic machinery.
reusable_weapons.do_not_transfer: A2 numerical coefficients, the -18 family, Q5 eliminations, delta sets, or family closure.

reusable_weapons.name: COMMON_JACOBIAN_COMPRESSION_OF_TWO_COVERS
reusable_weapons.pattern: After two-cover parameterization, compute exact binary-quartic invariants and merge covers sharing one Jacobian; source-lock an actual Q-isomorphism rather than same-j only.

reusable_weapons.name: COMPLETE_COVER_POINTSET_PULLBACK_WITH_LANDMARKS
reusable_weapons.pattern: Once an auxiliary cover point set is complete, explicitly map every finite point, chart pole, and projective infinity back through each prior parameterization and close only the represented source family.

critical_difference.StageA2: Its final common Jacobian had rank 0 and exactly eight rational points, so complete enumeration followed immediately.
critical_difference.Stage34: The seven current common Jacobians have rank 1 or 2; StageA2 rank-zero closure does not transfer. The reusable gain is the successive factor-cover descent before or alongside the MW sieve.
